item.title: Composer Craig Armstrong: "I don’t think anybody realised the impact the film Love Actually would have"
item.description: Glasgow composer Craig Armstrong has released his new work Pacific today. Written for piano, cello, and electronics, the three-movement piece was originally commissioned by Christian Kellersman, a pioneering figure in contemporary classical and jazz music, for his new live event series Berlin Confidential, co-curated with Alexander Szlovák.
